summary: L09 LN-093-T02 (sales-return -> purchase-return split per roll provenance) and LN-090-T01 (replacement shipment blocked before QC) tested via backend pytest (33/33 pass incl. regression L08 suites + 12 new extra tests) and UI E2E on ?view=returns&entity=ent_ksc. Split per (supplier, PO) works: 3 rolls (KSC/PO-00001, CST/PO-00001, unknown+manual supplier) -> PRET-00017/18/19, success msg lists 'PRET → supplier (PO)', linked badge persists after reload, second/parallel calls rejected, yard unit preserved on PR item, status matrix for shipped_to_customer correct. Minor UI/consistency issues found (below). All TEST_ data cleaned.

minor.issue: LN-090 guard is a blocklist (draft/pending_approval/approved/inspecting). Returns in status 'rejected' or 'cancelled' still accept milestone shipped_to_customer (200) — replacement can be marked shipped for a rejected/cancelled return. Consider allowlist {inspected, *_settled} or also block rejected/cancelled.

Pre-existing: only returns 2 internal group suppliers (entity_id=ent_ksc); suppliers with entity_id='all' (CV Grey Mandiri Majalaya, PT Benang Sejahtera Abadi, etc.) are excluded by resolve_list_scope. In the LN-093 modal the manual fallback supplier dropdown therefore cannot pick real external suppliers. Same endpoint used by PurchaseReturns, RFQ, BlanketPO, MakloonWizard.

ui_bugs.issue: Select shows option label 'Otomatis (dari PO terakhir produk)' (value '') instead of placeholder 'Otomatis per roll (supplier & PO asal roll)' because the empty-value option is selected by default. The label text contradicts the new LN-093 logic (no longer 'latest PO of product'). Rename option label to 'Otomatis per roll (supplier & PO asal roll)' or remove the '' option.

When submit fails (e.g. 'Supplier asal tidak tercatat pada roll ...'), the error is rendered in the panel behind the modal overlay (quarantine-err), barely visible while modal stays open. Show error inside the modal.

issues: Roll length hardcoded 'm' (shows '10,0 m' for a yard-based product while Jejak Retur shows 'yard') — pre-existing.

action_items: Fix modal option label 'Otomatis (dari PO terakhir produk)' -> match new per-roll provenance wording (ReturnQuarantinePanel.jsx ~line 419)
Consider blocking shipped_to_customer for rejected/cancelled returns (return_service.mark_milestone ~line 602)
Investigate /api/suppliers scope excluding entity_id='all' suppliers (manual fallback list incomplete)
Optional: show create-purchase-return error inside the modal; consider disabling quarantine Release for rolls already attached to a pending purchase return
critical_code_review_comments: create_from_sales_return: rolls stay 'quarantine' until PR approval; Release button in quarantine panel remains enabled for rolls already listed in pending PRs — release-to-stock then PR approval would consume them from available stock (sold/reserved risk). Consider a hold/lock flag.

Partial failure path: if branch N fails after branches 1..N-1 created, sales return is linked to the partial set and a 400 is raised; retry is impossible (already linked) — remaining rolls need manual handling. Acceptable but should be visible in UI.
roll_supplier_provenance does a DB lookup per acquired entry per roll (N+1); fine for small returns.
